title: English Practice Quiz 0799
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Advanced English 01: Choose the correct phrase: Neither the supervisor nor the guards?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: were available.

questions.question: Advanced English 02: The new procedure will ___ existing controls.?
Advanced English 03: Choose the correct passive sentence.?
options: The forms were reviewed by the manager.
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: The forms were reviewed by the manager..

questions.question: Advanced English 04: The correct phrase is?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: in accordance with the policy.

questions.question: Advanced English 05: The word feasible means?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: practical and possible to achieve.

questions.question: Advanced English 06: Choose the correct conditional sentence.?
options: If I were responsible, I would investigate the matter.
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: If I were responsible, I would investigate the matter..

questions.question: Advanced English 07: The data ___ been verified.?
Advanced English 08: A word meaning explain clearly with details is?
Advanced English 09: Choose the correct punctuation.?
options: The review covered safety, staffing, and maintenance.
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: The review covered safety, staffing, and maintenance..

questions.question: Advanced English 10: Choose the correct sentence.?
options: Despite the delay, the team completed the inspection.
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: Despite the delay, the team completed the inspection..
